name: Alcalá de Henares (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the arms of the city of Alcalá de Henares (a castle on blue above waves, beneath the crown of the Infantes of Castile).
history: The arms and flag of Alcalá de Henares were approved officially in 1987, published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado on 3 April 1987; the flag is a red field with the arms of the city at a distance from the hoist equal to half its length.

features.role: Alcalá de Henares arms — castle on blue above waves, beneath the crown of the Infantes of Castile
